response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle shift is underway. The once-majestic halls now echo with the soft hum of synthesizers and the gentle hiss of cassette tapes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard, a stout man with a bushy beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the traditional suits of armor, they wear pastel-colored jumpsuits and oversized sunglasses.

KING EVERARD
(to his advisor, Lord Ravenswood)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. One that blends the grandeur of our past with the... (he consults a worn VHS tape)...futurism of the future.

LORD RAVENSWOOD
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, what of our traditional aesthetic? Our coats of arms, our heraldry?

KING EVERARD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... last season. We must evolve. We must... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's gardens, once a lush oasis, are now transformed into a surreal dreamscape. Flowers bloom in neon hues, and the sound of gentle whispers and distant synths fills the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors gather around a large, ornate mirror. They gaze upon their reflections, and their eyes widen in surprise.

LORD RAVENSWOOD
(stunned)
By the saints... what have you done, Your Majesty?

KING EVERARD
(smiling)
I have created a new era. An era of... (he consults the VHS tape again)...retro-futurism.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The castle walls, once imposing and rugged, now feature a mesmerizing display of glitch art. The stone itself seems to warp and distort, like a VHS tape playing on repeat.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors gather around a large, ornate console. They press buttons, and a holographic display flickers to life.

ADVISOR 1
(amazed)
By the gods... this is incredible!

KING EVERARD
(smiling)
I told you, my friends. We are not just a medieval empire. We are... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans up to reveal the castle's new aesthetic: a swirling vortex of pastel colors, glitch art, and VHS tape static. The king's voice echoes through the air.

KING EVERARD
(to the camera)
Welcome to our new era. An era of vaporwave.
